notes.title: More Bug Fixes AND CHECKPOINTS ADDED!
notes.notes:
Added a few things, had to rush this update since there was a problem with loading object textures and it needed to be fixed so I have done that, I have also:



Made loading in to the playtest faster,

Added checkpoints to the practice mode (and playtest)

descriptions properly update now

respawning after death fixed (player spawns as the screen un-fades.



Join the discord to see more announcements and have your levels showcased at some point will be working on more updates as time goes by: https://discord.gg/fSt6Buxgrs

notes.title: Minor Early Update Patches
notes.notes:
Just a few patches to the new level editor:



Fixed issues with duplicating any objects.

You can now place objects closer to each other.

Fixed some convenience bugs in the editor.

Fixed visual bugs when completing a level in practice mode.

Added visual confirmation of updating descriptions.



I will be posting more updates and changes here and on my discord server, there you can also let me know about any bugs you may find and possibly earn special roles and show off some levels!

JOIN THE SERVER! > https://discord.gg/fSt6Buxgrs



Hope everyone is enjoying the update!

notes.title: Slight Gameplay Changes
notes.notes: small update to increase the player jump power very slightly. Should make some of the very difficult jumps slightly better to attempt.

notes.title: OFFICIAL GAME RELEASE!
notes.notes:
The game is only going to get better from here,



So far, you can unlock skins, steam achievements, play two special modes, as well as beat the main game.



I am working on a custom level editor (progress updates on my media) giving players the chance to create their own levels and share it with the world the play, offering endless content to enjoy!



That on top of many more updates to come, I will try my best to make this game as good as it can be!



Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cube_jump_game/

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@xenrikstudios



Make sure to follow the game and leave a review if you enjoyed it! I would love to hear what everyone thinks.
